text:
Ava (People Ops): Hey team — opening nominations for the Q2 Micro-Grant & Recognition program! :tada: Quick summary below and a few logistics questions. Please RT and nominate folks by EOD next Wed (1762104723). Form: https://tiny.redwood/recog-q2 (internal).
Sam (People Ops): Love it. Is the micro-grant amount still $500 per recipient?
Ava (People Ops): Yes — $500 + a custom note from leadership. We have budget for up to 30 micro-grants this quarter.
Jules (Eng): Can nominations be retroactive? Like, if someone had a standout in early April can we nominate now?
Ava (People Ops): Yup — retroactive to start of Q2 is allowed. We're mostly focused on impact and stories.
Rajat (Sales): Do nominations need manager sign-off before submission or after?
Ava (People Ops): Prefer manager sign-off on the nomination (one checkbox in the form). If a manager is OOO we can accept quick Slack approval screenshot.
Maya (Design): Suggestion: allow emoji-based nominations in #random to surface folks, then we can move to formal form for finalists. Low friction first step.
Sam (People Ops): Good idea. We can run a two-step flow: reactions in #random -> People Ops scrapes top 10 -> formal form for those names.
Ava (People Ops): That works. We'll post a pinned message in #company-recognition and #random. Can someone draft the pinned text?
Sam (People Ops): I'll draft and post by EOD today.
Jules (Eng): Small logistics Q: will recipients get physical swag at the offsite or a digital card + micro-grant?
Ava (People Ops): We'll do both: digital $500 grant + a small on-site token (lapel pin + certificate). If recipients are remote and not at offsite we'll ship the token.
Rajat (Sales): Any engraving/trophy for team-level awards? We have one cross-functional team I'd love to nominate for "Customer Hero".
Ava (People Ops): We have one team trophy budget per quarter. Put team award in the form under "Team nomination" and mark "trophy requested".
Maya (Design): Can we include an optional 100-word prompt asking "What did they do and why it mattered" — makes it easier for judges.
Ava (People Ops): Yes — 100-200 words ideal. We'll add that to the form.
Sam (People Ops): Quick reminder about timelines: nominations close Wed (1762104723) 17:00 PT. Review by People Ops + 2 exec judges by Fri. Awards announced Mon following week.
reward-bot: Nomination form opened. Total budget remaining: 30 micro-grants. Link: https://tiny.redwood/recog-q2
Jules (Eng): One more — are peer nominations anonymous to the judges?
Ava (People Ops): Judges see the anonymized story + impact. People Ops will redact names for the scoring pass; leadership sees names at final selection for FYI.
Rajat (Sales): Cool. I'll push a reminder email to the Sales all-hands and ask managers to encourage nominations.
Maya (Design): I'll post a short Loom showing how to fill the form for folks who ask.
Sam (People Ops): Perfect. After awards we should snapshot a gallery in Confluence and add short blurbs for the folks — helps career paths.
Ava (People Ops): Agreed. I'll own the gallery. Thanks everyone! :sparkles: (reaction :thumbsup: by Sam)
